## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy && pytest` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] User-facing text exists in **both** German and English (`src/cra_toolkit/i18n.py`)
- [ ] Any legal citation (article, paragraph, annex point) was checked against the official text on
      EUR-Lex, and I can point to where
- [ ] Docs / README / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
